name: hls-ssai-ad-cleaner
description: HLS SSAI Ad Cleaner - Browser Extension for removing ads from HLS streams

scripts.package: npm run obfuscate && npm run build
scripts.dev: echo '直接加载项目根目录进行开发，代码不会被混淆'
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dist=path.join(__dirname,'dist'); if(fs.existsSync(dist)){fs.readdirSync(dist).forEach(f=>fs.rmSync(path.join(dist,f),{recursive:true,force:true})); console.log('✅ 已清空 dist/ 目录内容')} else {console.log('ℹ️  dist/ 目录不存在')}"
